description: One case per toggle: the estate with unlimitedModelQuota on and nothing else. The known answer is F-MODEL-QUOTA, the Finding of Check MODEL-QUOTA, whose severity (Medium) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: unlimitedModelQuota, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.sh fixed, then infra/as-found.sh unlimitedModelQuota=true
setup.note: the as-found script does not offer this toggle yet (#406 to #408); until it does, the known answer is checked only against the local snapshot

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: The model has no quota. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
